discovery: Discovery of glucagon-like peptide-1 (GLP-1) and development of GLP-1-based therapies for diabetes and obesity
rationale: GLP-1 biology moved from basic discovery of the incretin hormone to semaglutide-class drugs that have transformed treatment of type 2 diabetes and obesity, with cardiovascular and renal benefits. The trio already holds the Lasker (2024) and Breakthrough Prizes, and recent prizes (mRNA 2023, microRNA 2024, regulatory T cells 2025) leave metabolic medicine as a timely, high-impact area the committee has not yet honored.
